reason: The cleaning bench is the obvious place to treat the dust-coated solar supply.
expectation: The panel sections will be cleaned at the bench.

effect: The arrays are clean and producing power again; the well and fuel fab still need restoring.
reaction: The careful cleaning and reconnection make the restored output feel earned.
reason: The service panel controlled the storm shutdown, so the restored solar supply is the natural way to select solar operation again.
expectation: The panel will restore solar operation and bring the well and fuel fab back online safely.

effect: Solar operation is restored, with the well checked and primed before the fuel fab restarts; the chapter is complete.
reaction: The staged restart was reassuring and more physically specific than a simple power switch.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restoring solar operation was most worthwhile: the checks, priming and separate tank refill made recovery from the storm feel consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cleaning the panels was straightforward and left little to decide, though it was a sensible first step.

surprise.text: The restart explicitly primed and checked the well before reopening the fuel-fab feeds, and acknowledged propellant lost to boil-off.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; both followed clearly from the dust storm and the earlier shutdown.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the recovered station and the frozen discovery affect the return journey, although this chapter offered few difficult decisions.
